name: MiniMax H3 - Reference to Video
description: Animate one or more reference images in a new scene while preserving subject identity. Core MiniMax H3 ref2va workflow with synchronized audio.
license_note: MiniMax H3 Community License: the weight-use grant excludes the United States, EU, UK and South Korea, and commercial use is capped at $20M annual revenue.

prompt_guide.style: Reference-to-video prompt. Describe the target scene, subject action, camera, and synchronized sound. Refer to supplied images with <Picture N> tags and explicitly preserve the identity, face, body, clothing, and distinctive details from each reference. Avoid calling reference images keyframes.
examples: Use <Picture 1> as the exact identity and outfit reference for the young woman. She walks through a rain-soaked neon alley, turns toward the camera, and smiles faintly. Slow tracking shot, shallow depth of field. Audio: rain, distant traffic, soft footsteps, and quiet ambient synth.

Preserve <Picture 1> as the product reference. The silver headphones rotate slowly on a dark studio pedestal while a soft rim light traces the earcups. Macro camera orbit, clean reflections. Audio: restrained electronic pulse and subtle metal movement.
